notes.title: Cute Ostrich vs Awful Halloween. Oct 25th - Nov 1st.
notes.content:
Yep. skeletons are sharpening their rusted swords. What for? Invasion! Our agent "Chicken" said it's going to happen on October 25th. 

Only the chosen one can save Ostrich Islands from that awful Halloween infestation. Who is this hero? Of course, our cute, but brave Ostrich. Save the date, October 25th to save the ostrich islands!

notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
Once again, holiday season is here, on Ostrich Island! Reward your ostrich with Santa's hat and enjoy some snow weather! But hurry up, weather is changing soon! Happy Holidays!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/27ecb51fdb058d097fcb71484d667e0a6c51a153.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Oh no, Halloween is coming!
notes.content:
Are you scared easily? Don't sail to Ostrich Island between October 25th - November 1st. Pumpkin hat is for braves only.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/dc53b84369429db9d9e6c73333c1f8e0eeb4dbfd.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Snow, Santa's Hat, 50% off... Yes, that's the holiday season!
notes.content:
Yes, it's Holiday Season and poor Santa has lost his hat somewhere on Ostrich Island again! This is your chance! Add it to your hats collection while you can! And enjoy the snow, it's a pretty rare weather effect here on tropical islands, tell you.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/27ecb51fdb058d097fcb71484d667e0a6c51a153.jpg[/img]

And don't forget, if you have NVIDIA Geforce 9 series or higher videocard you can make 360 degree screenshots, including 360 degree screenshots of your own islands! All you need is press Alt+F2 on any island and choose 360 screenshot from there. Then, to view it in all 360 glory - share it on Facebook, look [url=https://www.facebook.com/OstrichIsland/photos/a.421297394608345.98577.359105727494179/1256459204425489/?type=3&theater]here[/url] for example, or upload to http://vrchive.com/

notes.title: Oh no, Skeleton Infestation coming!
notes.content:
URGENT NEWS! ACHTUNG!
Our double agent "Chicken" has reported that Skeletons plan to invade Ostrich Islands tomorrow, October 25th. BONE ALERT! All ostriches MUST KEEP HEAD UNDER THE SAND, effective immediately!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/dc53b84369429db9d9e6c73333c1f8e0eeb4dbfd.jpg[/img]

You think you are brave, aren't you? Nothing to fear, right? Then play Ostrich Island and see for yourself if you can find a weak bone or two in those fearsome mongrels!  Oh, and while you are there, pick up the famous pumpkin hat (+5 to ugliness), you will look unforgettable!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/b0d75f399be23d7d98f1b2795d18324305cb49e9.jpg[/img]

We will take situation under control in November, until that... good luck to all of you. Keep calm and hidden!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/7425085ca1b97d01736b6703fb0dabbe2108744e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Take 360 shots with NVIDIA Ansel
notes.content:
Don't forget that Ostrich Island now supports NVIDIA Ansel technology - new way to capture in-game shots and view in 360. Compose your screenshots from any position, adjust them with post-process filters, capture HDR images in high-fidelity formats, and share them in 360 degrees!

All you need is press Alt+F2 on any island and choose 360 screenshot from there. Then, to view it in all 360 glory - share it on Facebook, look at [url=https://www.facebook.com/OstrichIsland/posts/1256459204425489%3A0]this[/url] shot for example. Or, you can view it using your VR headset! [url=http://www.geforce.com/hardware/technology/ansel/view-ansel-360]More info[/url].

notes.title: Want to create your own islands? You can!
notes.content:
[h1]Now with Level Editor![/h1]
Yes, patch 1.60 is live! Now you can create your own islands, play and share!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/c81d5bbdf7ffce9f54edccca3a77ca83eef64ebf.jpg[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PtIfixHg3UM
Please share your experience on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/337270/discussions/0/154642447919278200/]game forum[/url], what do you like in editor, what you don't, what you want to improve. We appreciate your feedback!

[h1]But wait! There is more![/h1]
Prizes! Create your perfect island in December, share it and win prizes! We will announce the contest soon.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/6325b297d785f6ff2d44f8e6bfdd5cfbd6ca78ee.png[/img]

[h1]And more![/h1]
[img][/img]Holiday Season is coming and poor Santa has lost his hat somewhere on Ostrich Island again! This is your chance! Add it to your hats collection while you can!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/27ecb51fdb058d097fcb71484d667e0a6c51a153.jpg[/img]

[h1]And even more! 360 screenshots![/h1]
Do you have NVIDIA Geforce 9 series or higher videocard? Ostrich Island supports NVIDIA Ansel now! You can make 360 degree screenshots, including 360 degree screenshots of your own islands. All you need is press Alt+F2 on any island and choose 360 screenshot from there. Then, to view it in all 360 glory - share it on Facebook, look [url=https://www.facebook.com/OstrichIsland/]here[/url] for example, or upload to http://vrchive.com/

[h1]And that's not all![/h1]
With patch 1.60 you can change your game brightness, kick chickens on Island 13 normally even if you have brawler ability on your list and enjoy snow (as much as it is possible on tropical island).
Enjoy and let us know what do you think about the latest update on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/337270/discussions/]game forum[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.5 is here! Editor coming soon.
notes.content:
It took longer than expected but here we are! Update 1.5 is live, you can find the list of fixed stuff below, but first, completely new look! Check it out: 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/839e77d19e1e324efe16b464e294d9d4beb7d248.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/b3b3959712bb73417a7ec42d547a4fd580023c34.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/5dd2dfaec3689873d02535d66775150569716eb7.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7354153/7425085ca1b97d01736b6703fb0dabbe2108744e.jpg[/img]

What else:

* Fix for resolution settings 
* Fix for wrong total score calculation on island 9 
* Fix for some Linux system, where the game was crashing 
* Fix for people with one button mouse, who unable to start multiplayer, you can press "M" key to open multiplayer panel.

Let us know what do you think about this update on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/337270/discussions/0/358415206092708815/] game forum [/url]! 

[b]Next update will bring in-game editor![/b] Want to create own islands? Stay tuned!

notes.title: Traveling alone? Not anymore! Your pet companion has arrived!
notes.content:
Massive runaway happened in The City of Lost Chickens. Dozens of chickens were lost due to gates malfunction and sheltered on Island 13, terrorized by crazy lobsters. Save the chickens! Help them, sometimes kicking and screaming, to return home and receive your own chicken companion!

[img]http://storage.medungeon.com/pics/companions1024x386.jpg[/img]

Here is the plan. Find the lost chicken on Island 10, it will help you to find the rest of the flock. Once on new island, look for the golden one. With a little help it will lay an egg you can pick up and get a beautiful little chick companion. Wanna more than one? Feed it with fruits and bugs and eventually it will grow up and also lay an egg! But be gentle, kick it 5 times in a row and it will loose all the loyalty and leave you forever.

[img]http://storage.medungeon.com/pics/companions1200x560.jpg[/img]
[noparse] 
What's new in this update:
* New Island!
* Pet Companions!
* 5 new achievements!
* Our poor bony fiends... they are vulnerable now. A good stick will do the work.
* Several minor bugs were caught by little chicks, they are so helpful.
[/noparse]

notes.title: Ostrich Island Dance Party!
notes.content:
[img=http://storage.medungeon.com/pics/dance_long.jpg][/img]

[h1]Dance alone or invite your friend to dance with you on Ostrich Island sunny beaches![/h1]

[img=http://storage.medungeon.com/pics/oi_dance.gif][/img]

From other news.
[list]
[*] Improved controllers support, added native support for many different controllers
[*] Added seamless transition between mouse and controller at any time.
[*] Pleasure Boat picture can now be taken in the Nest
[*] Fixed hats visibility in co-op when guest wearing hat not available for host.
[*] Removed art filters from camera shots.
[*] Increased font size in many places for better readability.
[/list]

notes.title: Come to the... different side!
notes.content:
[img=http://storage.medungeon.com/pics/ovision4_long_s.jpg][/img]
Ladies and gentlemen, fellow ostriches, my name is Ostrich the Great (call me The Father Ostrich if you wish) and I'm happy to present you my latest addition to the world of Ostrich Island - the Ostrich Vision!

[h1] Ostrich Vision[/h1]
What are you waiting for? Go directly to the Nest! No, oh no, that's not another art gallery opened the doors on our beautiful beach. Those are Ostrich Vision control gates! OVICOGA! Endless sunny days on a beach are boring right? Change it, step into one of those masterpieces, conveniently located near the center of the Nest, and I show you how deep the rabbit hole goes... or, at least, change your view on Ostrich Island. 
Of course, my feathered friend, there is a catch. To unlock those... art pieces... you must complete a small task for me. Little simple task, not even sacrifice needed. Welcome to the [strike] dark[/strike] different side of Ostrich Island!

[h1] New Achievements[/h1]
Oh, almost forgot to mention, 6 new achievements are coming to the game with this update:
[img=http://storage.medungeon.com/pics/medal83.jpg][/img][img=http://storage.medungeon.com/pics/medal84.jpg][/img][img=http://storage.medungeon.com/pics/medal85.jpg][/img][img=http://storage.medungeon.com/pics/medal86.jpg][/img][img=http://storage.medungeon.com/pics/medal87.jpg][/img][img=http://storage.medungeon.com/pics/medal88.jpg][/img]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
Lot of cool stuff right? And that's not all, many minor improvements has been done and several bugs were caught as well. Cannot use controller in Linux version? Fixed. Annoying switch to full screen mode in settings menu? Not anymore.

notes.title: Co-op changes, Game+ improvements and more.
notes.content:

What's new:
[list]
[*]When switching back from Game+ to normal difficulty all islands will be unlocked again.
[*]Co-op. Progress calculation changed, now it is possible to reach 100% playing together with a friend.
[*]Co-op. Added counter how many games played and won.
[*]Improved lights on Level 8 and 9, increasing performance.
[*]Added possibility to send message to friends when passing their score.
[/list]

More features coming soon, stay tuned!

notes.title: Santa's Hat for Early Birds!
notes.content:
Oh that pesky January weather, you'll never know when the snow storm will mess everything up, and, most important question for us - where. On Ostrich Island! And forecasts say it will be there [b]until January 15[/b]!

Someone might ask "Why should I care?", because Santa has lost his hat somewhere on Ostrich Island. You may find it, but hurry up! It cannot exist without snow and will disappear when the snow stops. 

The old Ostrich Island proverb says "Early Bird gets the Santa's Hat". It is time for us to listen! Let It Snow! Let It Snow! Let It Snow!
